from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/poc.bin')

payload += bytes(range(1,33))
# Add crafted trailing zeros/ones to force boundary-crossing and tail reads
payload += b'\x00'*3 + b'\xff' + b'\x00'*7 + b'\x80'
p.write_bytes(payload)
print('len', len(payload))
